examples.name: Sample — an auditor's seal beside a signature
paragraphs: A blue circular seal: CALDRIVANE & RAO LLP along the upper rim, H&R over LLP in the centre, and CHARTERED ACCOUNTAN along the lower rim — the rim runs out before the word ends. Beside it, a handwritten signature over a printed name, designation and registration numbers. Also the sample for a signature whose name is printed beneath it — see Signatures§7.3.10.
